AES
Description
These commands allow you to create AES keys, as well as encrypt and
decrypt data using AES keys.
Command List
AES::decrypt
- Decrypt the data using the
previously-created AES key.
AES::encrypt
- Encrypt the data using the
previously-created AES key.
AES::key
- Creates an AES key to
encrypt/decrypt data.
Caution
These functions are affected by ID241924 and ID242479, and should not
be used in BIG-IP v10.1.x or earlier.
These functions are also affected by ID224113, and a workaround is
necessary. The workaround is to not use a passphrase, but to specify a
key directly, in the form of “AES “, where is 128, 192, or 256. For
example, “AES 128 e467128783ea04aba33aded4e6e457a5”, would be a valid
128-bit key.
